open_questions: Only 60 route/route_master relations exist in OSM for Pakistan (2026-09-16); 38 are railway/train relations. Most city bus/BRT systems have no relation at all.

Relations 13911249 (Red Metrobus track), 13911250 (Orange Metrobus), 19984670 (Lahore MBS), 10995086 (Multan Metro Bus), 20012008 (Zu SR 08), 20012341 (Zu DR 05) have way geometry but NO stop/platform members.
Route master 19857234 (TransPeshawar BRT) has no member routes; trolleybus relation 19857202 and bus 18946702 have a single member only.
Several Lahore Orange Line station nodes carry Urdu text in name= instead of name:ur (e.g. node names for Gulshan-e-Ravi, GPO, Baghbanpura, Dera Gujran).
Polyline length_km chains member ways in relation order; relations that include both carriageways (Islamabad Red/Orange Metrobus: 38.6 / 47.5 km) overstate one-direction length.
Railway relation 19920896 (Bahawalnagar-Fort Abbas) length query failed (Overpass 504); length_km null. Railway relations have no polyline (only computed length) to keep file size modest.
colour tags are sometimes non-hex (red, orange, gray); kept verbatim.
